title: Add a printable receipt page
description: Customers asked for a receipt they can print. Adds GET /api/orders/:id/receipt, an HTML page with the customer's name and the order's product, quantity and total. Includes tests and a README entry.

comments.issue: The user's name and the product name are put into the HTML without escaping, and both are free text (anyone can sign up with a name like `<script>...</script>`), so the receipt page runs injected script on the shop's origin: stored XSS. Escape them or render with React.
